name: BrowserPair
description: Connect AI agents to your existing Chrome with Standard or Developer permissions, durable tasks and outcome verification.

mcp.authentication: OAuth for connected AI apps; agent keys for direct integrations

execution: Paired Chrome extension in the user's connected profile; paired browser must be online.
planning: External AI app or a user-configured Agent Model for managed tasks.
dataFlow: Website sessions remain in the connected profile. Browser observations and task results can flow through BrowserPair to the connected AI app; this is not a local-only processing claim.
sourceCode: The main application source is private. The public organization contains documentation, examples, workflow guides, and community resources.

permissions.websites: All websites in both modes; Chrome host permission and managed policy still apply.
permissions.tools: All tools in both modes; advertised MCP tools differ by authentication surface.
permissions.developerConfirmations: No mode confirmations; task-requested confirmations still apply.
permissions.customization: No per-site allow lists or per-category switches.

observations: Full-document interactive refs, including offscreen controls with in_viewport; bounded captured text search via task_find and lists/tables via task_extract.
effectRecovery: Fresh observation and resolution required for uncertain effects; never replay them.
